name: Jump through the night from the minute-by-minute list
description: Validates that picking an event moves the replay to its time, marks that row as current and updates the anchor status.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /cases/eagle-s-2024 and wait up to 60 seconds for the 3D view (data-testid seabed-view) to reach data-state ready
In the list headed "25 December, minute by minute", click the row "Cinia detects a fault on C-Lion1"
Assert the replay clock reads "16:44 UTC", the clicked row has aria-current="step", and the anchor status reads "Anchor dragging on the seabed"
Click the row "Police and Border Guard board the tanker from helicopters"
Assert the replay clock reads "22:28 UTC", the line under it reads "26 Dec 2024, 00:28 in Helsinki", and the anchor status reads "Drag ended at 16:45"
Assert the row "Police and Border Guard board the tanker from helicopters" now has aria-current="step" and the C-Lion1 row no longer does
